https://twitter.com/komagin/
御検討の程、何卒宜しく御願い致します。

Hello! Hope you are well! I was interested in getting art of my bat sona Pan again! This time it would be them in a simple loose white shirt, shorts and flip flops, carrying 7/11 shopping bags full of bar ingredients like booze, snacks and bread! Could Pan have a large soft belly peeping out under the shirt, a great handful she can’t hide due to holding all the shopping at once! Maybe a weary/content look on her face, like she was working all last night and got hungover and fat…

オリキャラ・フォゼ(♀)が獲物を丸呑みにし、大きく膨れたお腹を撫でているシーンを御願い致します。

・頭から膝より下まで写っていて、膨れたお腹が強調される構図
・つるぷに、つやてか感を強調して頂ければ嬉しいです
